d: Microsoft says the outage that shut down Outlook, Teams and other Microsoft 365 services for close to a day was caused by a software bug in its gateway servers that had been sitting there since July. Its testing missed the bug because the test machines were less powerful than the ones it runs in real life. Extra traffic from Teams and servers that were already offline set it off, and at one point more than 80 per cent of the servers had stopped responding.
